drafts.subject: VoiceBridge AI x OpenBuilder in Singapore
drafts.body:
Hi Maya,

Saw VoiceBridge AI just opened its Singapore office last month. Most teams I talk to are under pressure to show real outcomes from AI, not just pilots.

I run The AI Capitol. We run OpenBuilder, a community of 8,000+ builders in Singapore, through partner rooms and events. We put AI vendors in front of builders and enterprise buyers, then turn that room into ongoing pipeline.

Open to a 20-minute look at whether an annual ecosystem partner slot (Partner S$24,000 / Anchor S$48,000), or a single S$6,000 partner room to start makes sense for VoiceBridge AI?

Lionel Sim
Founder, The AI Capitol
https://www.theaicapitol.com/presentation
